[[Smiting#Sovereign Smiting | Sovereign Smiting]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Smiting#Sovereign Smiting | Sovereign Smiting]]:''' On Hit: 4 to 24 [[Bane]] damage to [[Construct|Constructs]].
On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]]: If a construct struck by this weapon has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the construct has above 3000 Hit Points, it takes 300 damage.
